description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Falcon, adding {C}{C}.
When Falcon dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Falcon from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Falcon enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
